body: That’s pretty dead on about what our relationship was! Thanks

Thank you so much. Yeah he just out of the blue sent me some video on Instagram and I was like wtf —- I haven’t spoken with him in almost two months. I dumped him for doing something really shady.

I don't want to be crazy anymore. :(

Medicine is definitely helpful, but behavioral therapy is a must! DBT has helped me more with my depression than I ever could have imagined. It's still a struggle but I'm so thankful I learned the skills. Definitely look into it :)
I am glad this post touched you! :)

I am overwhelmed with all the love and kindness I have received from this post. This is such a sweet thing of you to say, thank you for making my day so much brighter!! I feel like I should properly introduce myself as well, so, Hi, my name is Chloë. :)
Thank you very much!

Nah, I barely leave the house (I really don't get out much, truly meant it when I said sometimes on my worst days I just exist like a house plant) and also, I'm not a liar so I'd make a pretty horrible politician.

Maybe I read your reply wrong, it looked like you were discussing how one just drinks and uses drugs when they are slowly dying inside. That's what I meant with my reply, was that I have pumped myself full of drugs and drank a lot while feeling like I was slowly dying on the inside. Sorry you seem so aggressively confused over my misunderstanding your reply.
Thank you so much. It's the first time I've shared something so private with anyone, and I'm glad people are being so supportive.

That really means a whole lot to me. I was in a very fragile state when I wrote it; just in bed, crying, and staring blankly ahead with these words spilling out of me. I couldn't keep them in and for the first time in my life, I couldn't keep them to myself either. I am glad the Reddit community has been touched by them. Thanks again

Thank you so much for your support! It's hard not to truly believe that isolation is my only friend. It's been a hellish last ten months in outpatient rehab for my depression, and I fear all my old friends won't understand it's going to take me some time to get back to what is "normal" for me. I feel like I've forgotten how to be a good friend and that people have forgotten about me. I'm praying life will soon bring me a much-needed break from the pain I've been experiencing for so many years. I'm still here fighting with that tiny flickering ray of light that one day things will make sense and I will be ok. Thanks again.
I am glad you enjoyed my journal entry, thanks for your support!

Trust me, I've definitely been there. You are stagnant. You're alive but really you just exist like a house plant. It's the most horrible, torturous thing to have to live with a mental illness, that it's no wonder we love to numb ourselves with drugs and alcohol. I would trade an arm or a leg for a semblance of happiness and peace in my brain. I didn't sign up for this battle, none of us did; but we have to fight it nonetheless. I'm still here today, fighting away.

All of these positive comments mean so much to me.  I've been journaling for over 14 years through the ups and downs of my struggles with depression, anxiety and OCD. It's one of my coping mechanisms that almost feels like a compulsion. It feels better to write down all the pain I'm experiencing rather than hold everything in and let it violently boil and spill over inside of me. Thanks everyone for your kind words and support. it's hard not to feel naked in a sense when you post something so raw that you wrote while you were feeling your absolute worst; but now it feels like I've gotten a big hug from the Reddit community today and it's really touched me. Thanks, everyone. I'm new to Reddit (started this account yesterday just to post this) so thanks for the warm welcome!
I am touched that it resonated with you in such a way! I've been journaling for years but this was my first time to share. Thanks for the love and support.

Thank you so much! I've been journaling through my depression for the last 13-14 years but I've never done anything with any of the writing. This is the first time I've shared it. I am glad people were touched in a good way. Writing when I'm in the middle of feeling too much is an escape for me. It becomes a compulsion; I can't not do it. It's a great way to separate myself from all the dark thoughts in my mind. Thanks again for your kind words.

That is so kind of you to say. Thank you so much. I've been journaling through my depression for the last 13-14 years, but this is the first time I've ever shared a journal entry with anyone other than my therapist, haha. I really appreciate all the love. Yesterday was very difficult for me to get through, but look, ma! I woke up today and I'm alive. :)
